quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on managing foul trouble during games
quotes.excerpt: I'm not trying to foul. If you can see a little one, they stop, go, so I'm like, it's just a little game in between the games.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: He's talked to you a little bit about the fouls. How are you working through that?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I mean, yeah, obviously I know, but I'm not trying to foul. If you can see a little one, they stop, go, so I'm like, it's just a little game in between the games, so pretty much just playing both of those and not fouling.
